The trial of Bankman-Fried, the former CEO and co-founder of collapsed crypto exchange FTX
Sam Bankman-Fried, the founder of failed cryptocurrency exchange FTX, is on trial for seven counts of wire fraud and conspiracy.
The prosecution painted Bankman-Fried as someone who knowingly committed fraud to achieve great wealth, power and influence
while the defense countered that the FTX founder acted in good faith, never meant to commit fraud or steal and basically got in over his head.
